an8.28:1.1: Then the Venerable Sāriputta approached the Blessed One…. The Blessed One then said to him:
an8.28:1.2: “Sāriputta, when a bhikkhu’s taints have been destroyed, how many powers does he possess by reason of which he can claim:
an8.28:1.4: “Bhante, when a bhikkhu’s taints have been destroyed, he possesses eight powers by reason of which he can claim:
an8.28:2.2: (1) “Here, Bhante, a bhikkhu with taints destroyed has clearly seen all conditioned phenomena as they really are with correct wisdom as impermanent.
an8.28:2.3: This is a power of a bhikkhu with taints destroyed on the basis of which he can claim:
an8.28:3.1: (2) “Again, a bhikkhu with taints destroyed has clearly seen sensual pleasures as they really are with correct wisdom as similar to a charcoal pit.
an8.28:3.2: This is a power of a bhikkhu with taints destroyed….
an8.28:4.1: (3) “Again, the mind of a bhikkhu with taints destroyed slants, slopes, and inclines to seclusion; it is withdrawn, delighting in renunciation, and is entirely finished with all things that are a basis for the taints.
an8.28:4.2: This is a power of a bhikkhu with taints destroyed….
an8.28:5.1: (4) “Again, a bhikkhu with taints destroyed has developed and well developed the four establishments of mindfulness.
an8.28:5.2: Since that is so, this is a power of a bhikkhu with taints destroyed….
an8.28:6.1: “Again, a bhikkhu with taints destroyed has developed and well developed the four bases for psychic potency …
an8.28:6.5: This is a power of a bhikkhu with taints destroyed on the basis of which he can claim:
an8.28:7.1: “Bhante, when a bhikkhu’s taints have been destroyed, he possesses these eight powers on the basis of which he can claim:
